visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a wide shot of a small Thai food stall located on a city street. The cart features a green awning and multiple signs with Thai and Chinese text. A woman in a black shirt and face mask is visible behind the counter. (2) A person's hand enters the frame holding two colorful paper drink carriers featuring illustrations of tea. One contains an orange-colored liquid in a plastic bag, while the other is empty. (3) A close-up shows hands wearing purple latex gloves stirring a dark brown concentrated tea base in a clear glass labeled with a Pepsi logo. A thick, yellow liquid, likely condensed milk, is poured into the glass and mixed thoroughly. (4) The orange tea mixture is poured into a clear plastic bag filled with white crushed ice. A person’s hand then holds the finished bag, now sealed with a rubber band, inside a decorative cardboard box. (5) A similar plastic bag containing a light green milk tea is presented in the same box. A yellow straw is inserted into the bag. (6) In a close-up, a reddish-brown dressing is poured from a plastic container into a bag containing shredded green papaya, tomatoes, and long beans. The bag is held and shaken vigorously to mix the ingredients. (7) Chopsticks lift a bundle of the translucent papaya salad from the bag, revealing red chili pieces and small seeds. (8) A white bowl filled with thin white rice noodles, minced pork, and red and green vegetables is shown. A metal spoon is used to toss the ingredients. (9) A different bowl containing mango chunks and a mound of white sticky rice is shown. Coconut milk is poured from a small plastic bag onto the rice. (10) The camera pans down a long menu board listed in Chinese and Thai. The video ends with a wide shot of the stall again, overlaid with green location text boxes.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The background consists of a busy outdoor night market street in Kaohsiung, Taiwan. Buildings with air conditioning units are visible above the stalls. The food cart is decorated with Thai-style flower garlands and menu boards written in both Thai and Chinese.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, rhythmic acoustic guitar melody accompanied by a steady percussion beat. A male narrator introduces the night market stall with an enthusiastic and friendly tone. (2) A distinct, sharp metallic clinking sound occurs as a spoon stirs liquid in a glass container. The music continues at a consistent tempo in the background. (3) A soft, continuous splashing sound follows, representing liquid being poured into a plastic bag. The narrator describes the richness of the Thai milk tea while the music maintains its joyful mood. (4) A series of crinkling plastic rustling sounds are heard as the packaging is handled. The narrator transitions to discussing the green papaya salad. (5) Another splashing sound occurs, suggesting the addition of dressing to a bag, followed by rhythmic rustling as the bag is shaken to mix the contents. (6) A slight clinking of utensils against a bowl is heard. The narrator highlights the minced pork noodles with high vocal arousal and positive energy. (7) A gentle pouring sound of a thicker liquid occurs as coconut milk is added to the sticky rice. The music begins to wind down slightly as the narrator provides the final location details. (8) The video concludes with the narrator's cheerful sign-off over the fading acoustic music track and faint ambient urban street noise.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Showcase of Signature Drink -> Preparation Detail -> Salad Introduction -> Main Dish Reveal -> Dessert Reveal -> Menu/Price Display -> Location & CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional food review aimed at showcasing a specific Thai street food stall in Kaohsiung. It utilizes high-energy narration, fast-paced editing, and close-up visual food porn to appeal to local foodies and tourists. By highlighting unique packaging (bag-in-a-box) and a variety of authentic-looking Thai dishes, it encourages viewers to visit the Jilin Night Market to try the stall for themselves.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features a specific address, price points, and a strong recommendation of specific menu items, which is typical of social media food influencer content.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses the 'bag-in-a-box' drink packaging as a visual hook to grab attention. The fast pace and high-density text overlays are characteristic of modern short-form video marketing common on platforms like TikTok or Instagram Reels.
